name: Wallis and Futuna
summary_text: Wallis and Futuna: French civil/criminal code applies, but chiefly/mission governance dominates social life. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: France (0.67) plus a local delta of -0.08. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to Wallis and Futuna as a French overseas collectivity applying French law.

CGLPL opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (French context, applicable in Wallis and Futuna): serious violations persist across places of detention.

sources.title: Transgender rights in Wallis and Futuna — Grokipedia
sources.claim_summary: Grokipedia page on transgender rights in Wallis and Futuna: French metropolitan law applies - judicial gender-marker change without surgery or diagnosis since 2016-17 reforms; gender-identity anti-discrimination protections since 2012; but isolation, ~11,000 population and Catholic/Polynesian norms create practical barriers; no local specialists (travel to France or New Caledonia needed); traditional third-gender concepts (fakafafine) coexist with stigma; no non-binary recognition.
